Currency Act
(Chapter 69)
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 1st February 2010 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date “2010” below it and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coin. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o’clock of the proof coin.
The design reflects the transition of Singapore’s housing landscape over the past 50 years, from slums and squatter housing to high-rise living in vibrant and sustainable towns.
The backdrop features 2 existing residential housing developments and a block in stylised rendition to symbolise the future. At the foreground are 4 children of the main ethnic races playing in lush communal space, representing racial harmony and living in public housing estates.

The figure “50” and the words “Celebrating 50 Years of Public Housing” are at the top of the coin. Stylised fireworks have been incorporated on the left and right edges to convey the overall celebratory mood of the event.
The denomination of the coin in figures is at the left circumference of the coin.
